title: Provably Accurate Shapley Value Estimation via Leverage Score Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2410.01917v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Originally introduced in game theory, Shapley values have emerged as a central tool in explainable machine learning, where they are used to attribute model predictions to specific input features. However, computing Shapley values exactly is expensive: for a general model with $n$ features, $O(2^n)$ model evaluations are necessary. To address this issue, approximation algorithms are widely used. One of the most popular is the Kernel SHAP algorithm, which is model agnostic and remarkably effective in practice. At the time of our original submission, no strong non-asymptotic complexity guarantees were known for Kernel SHAP. We address this issue by introducing Leverage SHAP, a lightweight modification of Kernel SHAP that provides provably accurate Shapley value estimates with just $O(n\log n)$ model evaluations. translated_abstract: Shapley值最初源于博弈论，如今已成为可解释机器学习中的核心工具，用于将模型预测归因于特定的输入特征。然而，精确计算Shapley值的代价十分高昂：对于一个具有 $n$ 个特征的一般模型，需要进行 $O(2^n)$ 次模型评估。为解决这一问题，近似算法被广泛采用，其中最流行的算法之一是Kernel SHAP，该算法与具体模型无关，且在实践中表现出色。在我们最初提交论文时，Kernel SHAP尚缺乏强有力的非渐近复杂度保证。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Leverage SHAP，这是对Kernel SHAP的一种轻量级改进，仅需 $O(n\log n)$ 次模型评估即可提供可证明精确的Shapley值估计。我们的方法利用了Shapley值估计与不可知主动学习之间的联系，通过采用……
tldr: 提出Leverage SHAP，通过对Kernel SHAP的轻量级改进，利用杠杆分数采样将模型评估次数从指数级降至O(n log n)，实现了可证明精确的Shapley值估计。
en_tdlr: Leverage SHAP, a lightweight modification of Kernel SHAP, achieves provably accurate Shapley value estimation with only O(n log n) model evaluations via leverage score sampling.
